meta.face: Christ as in recurring-figures.md: a man of about thirty-three with a LONG OVAL face narrowing gently to the chin — a high, smooth forehead, a long straight nose with a fine bridge, calm almond-shaped dark-brown eyes under level brown brows, high, softly modelled cheekbones, a quiet closed mouth; chestnut-brown hair parted in the centre and falling in soft waves past the shoulders; a short, full chestnut beard and moustache, lightly parted at the chin; a plain gold halo; a rose-red tunic and a blue mantle; eyes lifted to the angel in sorrow and surrender. The angel is clearly different from him and from St. Michael: a youthful angel with a SOFT, ROUND face, a small straight nose, wide-set dark-brown eyes, full cheeks, a gentle mouth; short dark-auburn curls; a pale rose-gold robe and white wings edged in gold, no armour. The sleeping Apostles are small, faces half hidden: Peter as in recurring-figures.md, about sixty-five, a broad, weathered fisherman's face, a strong wide nose, deep-set earnest eyes, a lined forehead; curly grey-white hair balding from the back with a curly tuft at the forehead; a short, square, curly grey-white beard; a blue tunic and golden-ochre mantle; James as on the james_greater card, chestnut hair to the jaw and a short sparse beard; John as in recurring-figures.md, beardless with wavy golden-brown hair, in green and red-orange.
meta.basis: Luke 22:41-45 (the prayer, the strengthening angel) and Matthew 26:37-40 (Peter, James and John asleep); the angel with the cup is the standard devotional composition (Giovanni Bellini, Carlo Dolci, holy cards after Hofmann). Christ from recurring-figures.md.
